title: setDiscountRate allows 100% discount, enabling free strategy drain
justification: Owner mistake reachable via single setter: rate==10000 produces actualPayment==0; combined with the absent zero-payment guard (DEDUP-02), any NFT holder drains strategies for free. Per C4 known-invalid 'reckless admin mistakes' guidance, a single-setter misconfiguration with no economic incentive for the owner is a centralization concern, not High. The fix (require rate < 10000) is a basic input-validation hardening.
preconditions: Owner sets discountRate=10000 (no economic motive; pure error).
impact: If triggered, any NFT holder drains strategies for free until owner corrects. Compounded by DEDUP-02 (no zero-payment guard).
attack_path_summary: 1) Owner mistakenly sets discountRate=10000. 2) Any NFT holder calls claim(); actualPayment=0; strategies drained free. 3) Loss continues until owner re-sets discount.
centralization_framing: Honest classification: this is an admin mistake reachable in a single tx. Listed as Centralization with recommendation to add input validation (rate < 10000).
